definitions.clocks: Tick and endpoints are signed HMB cutoff ns on the recorder-relative timeline. The receive_ns pairs identify collector-relative original source times.
definitions.curl: One minus the projection of proximal-to-tip chord on the unit wrist-to-mean-proximal direction, divided by the four-landmark path length. Finger order is index, middle, ring, little.
definitions.guard_veto: C's extra V2 shadow result differs from PERMIT when the shared common gate permitted. Changed-command vetoes also require that C issued a different hand target.
definitions.measured_matching_proxy: Uses the same formulas on measured end-of-tick robot palm-local landmarks, with the robot palm body as origin. Human and robot proximal landmarks differ. Rapid counts overlap of input windows with robot-qualified windows for the same hand.
definitions.physics: Complete means ten archived 2 ms samples for that planned 20 ms tick, including holds. Measured movement is a net change of at least 0.001 rad in any named joint of the selected hand(s). Contact includes any archived MuJoCo contact pair on either hand or arm.

rules.asymmetric_hands: Mean absolute left-right difference across the four corresponding curls is at least 0.30.
rules.fist: Mean non-thumb curl is at least 0.60 and every non-thumb curl is at least 0.45.
rules.natural_open: All four non-thumb fingers have curl at most 0.25.
rules.one_finger_flexion: One non-thumb curl is at least 0.60 and every other non-thumb curl is at most 0.30.
rules.rapid_repeated_open_close: Five alternating stable open/fist runs on the same hand, with at most 0.50 s between the onset of successive runs. Missing valid observations break a sequence.
rules.spread: All four curls at most 0.35, index-little tip span at least 1.35 times proximal span, and at least 25 degrees between their proximal-to-tip chords.
rules.thumb_index_pinch: Thumb-index gap at most 20 mm and at least 5 mm smaller than every other thumb gap.
rules.thumb_middle_pinch: Thumb-middle gap at most 20 mm and at least 5 mm smaller than every other thumb gap.

definitions.source: Unrotated recorded MANUS positions from signed HMB selections. No historical gesture labels.
definitions.stability: At least three consecutive 50 Hz ticks and three distinct selected raw identities per side. Overlapping windows are counted once per tick within each aggregate.
